bios.one_liner: Principal Consultant at Synergetic Solutions. We build and stress test systems composed of people, processes, and technology resulting in fewer sales objections.
bios.short: Jeff Smolinski is Principal Consultant at Synergetic Solutions, where he builds and secures software and data systems for organizations that handle sensitive data. He led an employee benefit plan audit platform from MVP to $1M ARR in its first year, with a SOC 2 program certified in four months, and has helped clients win five Nebraska Innovation Grants totaling more than $375,000. A security researcher with two disclosed CVEs and peer-reviewed research, he holds an MS in Cybersecurity from the University of Nebraska Omaha. His open-source projects have passed 500,000 installs and downloads.
long: Jeff Smolinski is Principal Consultant at Synergetic Solutions, where he builds and secures software and data systems for organizations that handle sensitive data. He holds an MS in Cybersecurity (Cyber Operations) from the University of Nebraska Omaha.

As a security researcher, Jeff found and disclosed two cross-site scripting vulnerabilities in the Unicorn framework for Django (CVE-2021-42053 and CVE-2021-42134), which affected 249 repositories. He co-authored peer-reviewed research on LLVM fingerprinting, presented at the International Conference on Cyber Warfare and Security in 2022, and designed a secure audio DRM module for MITRE's 2020 Embedded Capture the Flag.

In client work, he led an employee benefit plan audit platform from MVP to $1M ARR in its first year, building a SOC 2 program that reached certification in four months and sitting on its governance committee. He served as CTO and board member of a scheduling platform, built data pipelines and a public hospital directory for a hospital capacity planning company, and has helped clients win five Nebraska Innovation Grants totaling more than $375,000.

At Synergetic he built the Trust Center Directory, which tracks the public compliance footprint of 9,300+ organizations, and a weekly agentic pipeline that turns real security incidents into tabletop exercises. His open-source work, including claude-skills, a library of 67 Agent Skills for Claude, has passed 500,000 installs and downloads.
His core competencies are application security, threat modeling, secure code review, reverse engineering, GRC programs (SOC 2, HIPAA, FERPA), data engineering and agentic software delivery.

bullets: Providing greenfield and legacy development as a service for client web apps and cloud infrastructure informed by security requirements, threat modeling, and secure code review.
Conducting technical due diligence to evaluate security compliance readiness, guide clients through compliance efforts, and deliver technical assessments to inform funding decisions.
Driving enterprise customer acquisition by architecting and implementing Governance Risk Compliance programs and authentication infrastructure that eliminate technical barriers in enterprise sales.
